BOTTOM LEFT: old iron and bronze with layered blue-green verdigris, rust speckles, scratched silver and dark pitting; no actual bolts or metal object. BOTTOM RIGHT: brown coarse rope-fibre surface texture, rich strand detail and salt grime, a flat material not a drawn rope or net. All swatches richly layered with intricate physical detail. Fully OPAQUE RGB alpha255 everywhere, no transparency, no corner fading, no vignette, constant even flat lighting. Flat top-down texture surfaces only, no fish, no stall, no 3D objects, flags, signs, emblems, words, framing or cast shadows. Reference is MATERIAL style only. Highest square resolution.
